question: What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
rendered: The NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode contained 200 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C, while the water-processed NMC 532 cathode contained 625 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C.
